BrochureContent.Content: Blue Sky Property is delighted to bring this exceptional property to the market, at The Mills of Louth. steeped in local social history, having previously been a country store and drapers…boasting lots of character, style, and comfort. As you approach the property, you'll be won over by the natural setting, beautiful gardens, mature trees, generous terraces, and picturesque countryside views. Upon entering the property, you'll fall in love with its uniqueness, layout, and accommodation. This super family home offers, a large living room perfect for relaxing and entertaining, with double doors to the formal dining room for special occasions over looking the gardens and terrace, a handcrafted country kitchen with luxurious marble tops, next a wonderful study-lounge for a home office or quiet retreat, utility room and guest wc for added convenience. Finally three generous bedrooms, providing ample space for family and friends and of course a very large family bathroom, perfect for busy households. Homes of this style and layout are extremely rare and always attract strong interest. Don't miss this opportunity to own a piece of history and make this stunning property your dream home. This property represents excellent value for money, offering a unique blend of history, character, and modern comforts. Don't wait – get in touch today to arrange a viewing and make this house your home. Contact Blue Sky Property on 042-9329333. Guide Price : €435,000
